request.query: The linear combination of a finitely supported function in a module is the weighted sum

items.name: Module.DualBases.lc
items.type:
{R : Type u_1} →
  {M : Type u_2} →
    [inst : CommSemiring R] → [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] → [Module R M] → {ι : Type u_4} → (ι → M) → (ι →₀ R) → M

items.name: Finsupp.linearCombination_onFinset
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} (R : Type u_5) [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M]
  {s : Finset α} {f : α → R} (g : α → M) (hf : ∀ (a : α), f a ≠ 0 → a ∈ s),
  (Finsupp.linearCombination R g) (Finsupp.onFinset s f hf) = ∑ x ∈ s, f x • g x

items.name: Finsupp.linearCombination
items.type:
{α : Type u_1} →
  {M : Type u_2} →
    (R : Type u_5) →
      [inst : Semiring R] → [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] → [inst_2 : Module R M] → (α → M) → (α →₀ R) →ₗ[R] M

items.name: Finsupp.linearCombination_apply
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} (R : Type u_5) [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M]
  {v : α → M} (l : α →₀ R), (Finsupp.linearCombination R v) l = l.sum fun i a => a • v i

items.name: Finsupp.linearCombination_apply_of_mem_supported
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} (R : Type u_5) [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_2 : Module R M]
  {v : α → M} {l : α →₀ R} {s : Finset α},
  l ∈ Finsupp.supported R R ↑s → (Finsupp.linearCombination R v) l = ∑ i ∈ s, l i • v i
